lines.en: I give Haruka a call and decide to spend some of the night at her place.
lines.zh: 我给 Haruka 打了个电话，决定晚上去她那儿待一阵。

lines.en: It's a mostly wholesome get-together, with the conversation never really going anywhere unsavory.
lines.zh: 这次聚会大体上很正经，话题始终没往什么不体面的方向跑。

lines.en: We sort of just sit around watching TV and reminiscing about when we were younger and further away from death.
lines.zh: 我们基本上就是坐着看电视，聊聊年轻时、离死亡还远的日子。

lines.en: I'm glad Haruka has a lot to say in that respect because I'm still having a hard time remembering anything from when I was young.
lines.zh: 这方面我很高兴 Haruka 有很多话可说，因为我至今仍想不起自己年轻时的任何事。

lines.en: I wind up getting a call from Ami in the middle of a movie Haruka and I are watching and am essentially forced to come home when I refuse to tell her where I am.
lines.zh: 我和 Haruka 看电影看到一半，Ami 打来电话，而当我拒绝告诉她我在哪儿时，基本上就被逼着回家了。

lines.en: I feel kind of weird letting a [teenage]girl boss me around but Haruka laughs and chalks it up to me only agreeing because I'm 'subconsciously worried' about her.
lines.zh: 被一个[十几岁]的女孩呼来喝去让我感觉有点怪，但 Haruka 笑了，说我只是「潜意识里担心她」才答应的。

lines.en: And even though that may be true, I can't help but feel a little bad for leaving Haruka on her own again with how often she talks about being lonely.
lines.zh: 虽然这话也许没错，但想到她常说自己寂寞，我又把她一个人留下，还是忍不住有点过意不去。

lines.en: Either way, it still seems like the two of us are growing closer...So that's definitely something to be happy about.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我们俩似乎还是在靠近……这肯定是值得高兴的事。
